arxiv-2010-01531.title: A pre-explosion extended effervescent zone around core collapse supernova progenitors
arxiv-2010-01531.creator: Noam Soker
arxiv-2010-01531.description: Abstract I propose a scenario according to which the dense compact circumstellar matter (CSM) that the ejecta of many core collapse supernovae (CCSNe) collide with within several days after explosion results from a dense zone where in addition to the stellar wind there is gas that does not reach the escape velocity.

arxiv-2112-08508.description: Abstract We report on the observation of time-resolved quantum beats in the helium fluorescence from the transition 1 ​ s ​ 3 ​ p → 1 ​ s ​ 2 ​ s 1s3p\,\rightarrow\,1s2s , where the initial state is excited by XUV free electron laser radiation.

arxiv-2301-10921.title: SoftMatch: Addressing the Quantity-Quality Trade-off in Semi-supervised Learning
arxiv-2301-10921.creator: Hao Chen 1 , Ran Tao 1∗ , Yue Fan 2 , Yidong Wang 3 Jindong Wang 3 , Bernt Schiele 2 , Xing Xie 3 , Bhiksha Raj 1,4 , Marios Savvides 1†
arxiv-2301-10921.description: Abstract The critical challenge of Semi-Supervised Learning (SSL) is how to effectively leverage the limited labeled data and massive unlabeled data to improve the model’s generalization performance. In this paper, we first revisit the popular pseudo-labeling methods via a unified sample weighting formulation and demonstrate the inherent quantity-quality trade-off problem of pseudo-labeling with thresholding, which may prohibit learning.

arxiv-2310-20054.title: Constrained Hierarchical Monte Carlo Belief-State Planning
arxiv-2310-20054.creator: Arec Jamgochian, Hugo Buurmeijer, Kyle H. Wray, Anthony Corso, Mykel J. Kochenderfer
arxiv-2310-20054.description: Abstract Optimal plans in Constrained Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (CPOMDPs) maximize reward objectives while satisfying hard cost constraints, generalizing safe planning under state and transition uncertainty. Unfortunately, online CPOMDP planning is extremely difficult in large or continuous problem domains.

arxiv-2312-17700.title: Fermi and Luttinger arcs: two concepts, one surface
arxiv-2312-17700.creator: Paul Worm, Matthias Reitner, Karsten Held, Alessandro Toschi
arxiv-2312-17700.description: Abstract We present an analytically solvable model for correlated electrons, which is able to capture the major Fermi surface modifications occurring in both hole- and electron-doped cuprates as a function of doping. The proposed Hamiltonian qualitatively reproduces the results of numerically demanding many-body calculations, here obtained using the dynamical vertex approximation.

arxiv-2401-13255.title: Constructing a fully homomorphic encryption scheme with the Yoneda Lemma
arxiv-2401-13255.creator: Rémy Tuyéras
arxiv-2401-13255.description: Abstract . This paper redefines the foundations of asymmetric cryptography’s homomorphic cryptosystems through the application of the Yoneda Lemma. It demonstrates that widely adopted systems, including ElGamal, RSA, Benaloh, Regev’s LWE, and NTRUEncrypt, are directly derived from the principles of the Yoneda Lemma. This synthesis leads to the creation of a holistic homomorphic encryption framework, the Yoneda Encryption Scheme.

arxiv-2401-15161.title: Individual and team performance in cricket
arxiv-2401-15161.creator: Onkar Sadekar, Sandeep Chowdhary, M. S. Santhanam, Federico Battiston
arxiv-2401-15161.description: Abstract Advancements in technology have recently allowed to collect and analyse large-scale fine-grained data about human performance, drastically changing the way we approach sports. Here we provide the first comprehensive analysis of individual and team performance in One-Day International cricket, one of the most popular sports in the world.

arxiv-2409-18849.title: Temperature anisotropy instabilities driven by intermittent velocity shears in the solar wind
arxiv-2409-18849.creator: Simon Opie \aff 1 \corresp, Daniel Verscharen \aff 1 Christopher H. K. Chen \aff 2 Christopher J. Owen \aff 1 Philip A. Isenberg \aff 3 Luca Sorriso-Valvo \aff 4,5 Luca Franci \aff 6 Lorenzo Matteini \aff 7
arxiv-2409-18849.description: Abstract Where and under what conditions the transfer of energy between electromagnetic fields and particles takes place in the solar wind remains an open question. We investigate the conditions that promote the growth of kinetic instabilities predicted by linear theory, to infer how turbulence and temperature-anisotropy-driven instabilities are interrelated.

arxiv-2511-17532.creator: Xiaoqian Qi, Haoye Chai, Sichang Liu, Lei Yue, Raoyuan Pan
arxiv-2511-17532.description: Abstract The planning, management, and resource scheduling of cellular mobile networks require joint estimation of mobile traffic across different layers and nodes. Mobile traffic generation can proactively anticipate user demands and capture the dynamics of network load. However, existing methods mainly focus on generating traffic at a single spatiotemporal resolution, making it difficult to jointly model multi-scale traffic patterns.

pmc-11489076.title: Informing HPV vaccine pricing for government-funded vaccination in mainland China: a modelling study
pmc-11489076.creator: Tingting You, Xuelian Zhao, Chenghao Pan, Meng Gao, Shangying Hu, Yang Liu, Yong Zhang, Youlin Qiao, Fanghui Zhao, Mark Jit
pmc-11489076.description: SummaryBackgroundThe high price of HPV vaccines remains a significant barrier to vaccine accessibility in China, hindering the country’s efforts toward cervical cancer elimination and exacerbating health inequity. We aimed to inform HPV vaccine price negotiations by identifying threshold prices that ensure that a government-funded HPV vaccination programme is cost-effective or cost-saving.

pmc-12950184.title: Dental microplastics as emerging neurotoxicants: a systematic review on human data
pmc-12950184.creator: Aiah Alkhamees, Dana Salha, Dana Alfailat, Danah Malallah, Dhewy Alazemi, Dunia Al Taharweh, Ebaa Al Borom, Asmaa Uthman, Musab Hamed Saeed, Natheer H. Al-Rawi
pmc-12950184.description: BackgroundMicroplastics and compounds linked to plastic have recently emerged as potential contaminants that might affect brain function; nevertheless, results from these investigations have been inconsistent across epidemiological, clinical, and mechanistic research. Whether in people or in vitro models, this systematic review sought to compile the most recent data on the link between exposures to microplastics and neurological effects.

pmc-13092162.title: Ethical guidelines for geoprivacy: a framework for researchers and ethics committees
pmc-13092162.creator: Milad Malekzadeh, Yan Kestens, Justine I Blanford, Camille Perchoux, Mir Abolfazl Mostafavi, Grant McKenzie, Eun-Kyeong Kim
pmc-13092162.description: BackgroundThe increasing use of geographic data about individuals in health and social research raises ethical challenges that extend beyond existing legal frameworks. While regulations such as data protection laws define boundaries, they rarely provide researchers with sufficient practical guidance for addressing geoprivacy risks.MethodsWe developed a structured, reflexive ethical framework tailored for research involving human-centered geographic data.

pmc-13187888.title: Lymphangitic breast cancer in explanted lungs with interstitial lung disease: an unexpected finding
pmc-13187888.creator: Giuseppe Maggioni, Omar El Mnif, Eleonora Faccioli, Monica Loy, Francesca Lunardi, Marco Schiavon, Fiorella Calabrese
pmc-13187888.description: SummaryA 60-year-old woman with end-stage fibrosing interstitial lung disease (ILD) underwent bilateral lung transplantation. Systematic histological analysis of the explanted lungs revealed extensive lymphangitic carcinomatosis and hilar lymph node metastases from a previously undiagnosed breast carcinoma. Retrospective imaging review identified a suspicious mammographic finding that had not been further investigated.
